name: Connecting Ridge Extension
ephemeris: JPL Horizons, airless apparent azimuth/elevation, 10-minute steps; model in source headers

science.frameEvidence: Gläser et al. 2018 state no frame; their terrain model is LOLA tracks (MOON_ME of DE421) co-registered to an LROC NAC terrain model. Check: on NASA's MOON_ME DE421 5 m maps this exact point gets 78.7% sunlight 2 m up against Gläser's 78.1%, while points 100 m away get a median of 50.7%, so the point agrees with MOON_ME_DE421 to well under 100 m.
